teachingQuestion: Which protection outcome is harmed in this scenario?
focalInsight: The five properties describe distinct failure consequences, so a control choice must begin with the property and business harm.
title: Five security properties, five questions
caption: Use the property that best describes the failure before selecting a control.

nodes.label: Availability
nodes.detail: Can authorized users use it in time?

nodes.label: Nonrepudiation
nodes.detail: Can an actor plausibly deny the action?

altSummary: A five-row comparison maps each security property to the question it answers.
textFallback: Confidentiality concerns unauthorized disclosure. Integrity concerns improper alteration or loss of correctness. Availability concerns timely authorized use. Authenticity concerns whether an identity or information source is genuine. Nonrepudiation concerns durable evidence that resists a later denial of an action.
